notes: PvP Pad v4 on Robinhood Chain (4663): a fresh deployment of launch 1764 (github.com/identity-md-launches/launch-1764-pvp-pad-v3-robinhood @c3a2fac8312fac1dabbd8deca78a987e180523c8) with bail-out, graduation into IMD and the two-hop burn. Contracts only: five applications deployed atomically in this order with zero ETH. No token is minted at deployment: no name, symbol, supply, pool, hook or distributor; PadToken and PadGame are sealed EIP-1167 templates (their constructors mark the template initialized), and every token including PVP is created later by PvPPad. PvPPad(owner, tokenTemplate, gameTemplate): owner is $owner, the launch owner 0x5b95a971b4583a5f011e9da082acdd679b870d06; the factory (msg.sender) never holds a role. PadLiquidity(poolManager, pad, imd, imdEthPoolId): poolManager is the Uniswap v4 PoolManager inherited from launch 1764, 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951; pad is the PvPPad just deployed (the constructor calls its one-shot bindLiquidity); imd is 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127, treated as a plain ERC20 with internal accounting; imdEthPoolId is the bytes32 PoolId 0xd2fc01ee6f8400b6b4ea3b341a188568f2bd6c72b07b96741a82396fa6eb8f02 of the live IMD/ETH key (currency0 native ETH, currency1 IMD, fee 10000, tickSpacing 100, no hooks). The constructor rebuilds PoolKey(address(0), imd, 10000, 100, address(0)) and reverts unless its keccak256 equals this id, so the key is passed as one static word and native ETH and no-hooks are fixed protocol constants rather than zero-address arguments. KingOfThePad(pad, liquidity, dev): dev, the king settlement recipient and reported owner(), is $owner; the constructor calls bindKing on PadLiquidity and startGenesis on PvPPad. Every constructor is nonpayable, takes only static words and calls nothing outside this manifest; no contract checks for external code at deployment (PoolManager and IMD are first used on chain), so the launch checks' empty chain deploys them. Nothing is called after deployment. The pad stays closed until openPad(salt), by the owner or by anyone after 30 days, deploys the permission-bit-mined PadHook and the genesis clones; PadHook is deliberately absent here. Runtime sizes (bytes): PadToken 2999, PadGame 19241, PvPPad 11288, PadLiquidity 18044, KingOfThePad 2829, all under 24576, no linked libraries, no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. Behaviour: during play a seated wallet may bailOut(minOut), selling all its coins back to the curve and erasing its seat; bail-out pot additions do not raise rollPot and the funded release cap uses net curve ETH. After finalize, convertChunk(game) (public and in bounded upkeep) converts net curve ETH to IMD in 1% price-limited chunks at most once per 30 s per game through PoolManager.unlock with own funds; graduate() then seeds a sorted coin/IMD pool (fee 10000, tickSpacing 200, hooks PadHook) at the equivalent of the final curve price, full range, LP owned forever by PadLiquidity, excess coins to dEaD, token unlocked in the same tx. If conversion makes no progress for 24 h the game graduates with the IMD converted so far and unconverted ETH goes to the carry pot; with no IMD at all it graduates into a coin/ETH pool as v3. burnChunk buys PVP through ETH -> IMD -> PVP in one unlock, each hop 1% price-limited, 0.02 ETH per 10 min. Raffle, tips, king settlement, reign stamps, upkeep gas caps and carry rules are kept; king fees stay in kind (IMD and coins). See docs/AUDIT.md, docs/TEST-REPORT.md and docs/VERIFY.md (robin.etherscan.io). Legal review and an independent audit are required before public launch. This assignment deployed nothing, broadcast nothing and called no RPC.
